description: A humble forge capable of basic repairs and simple craftsmanship. Specializes in melee weapons, shields, and heavy armor.
keeper_description: Bald bearded muscular man in a soot-stained leather apron, heavy hammer resting on his shoulder, forge glowing behind him
keeper_greetings: Good day, ShopKeeper! What would you like to discuss today?
Ah, welcome back! The forge is hot and ready.
Need something hammered into shape? You've come to the right place.
